Matéo Molinaro is a junior Quantitative Equity Researcher at a systematic asset manager, where he specializes in low-mid frequency systematic equity strategies. He previously interned as a quantitative equity researcher at BNP Paribas Asset Management, Candriam, and Scientific Beta, working on alpha research and portfolio construction, and interned at Lazard Asset Management as a fundamental equity analyst, presenting stock pitches to portfolio managers.

Matéo holds a Master's degree in Quantitative Finance (MSc 272) from Paris-Dauphine and a Specialized Master (MS) in Data Science from ENSAE. He is also a lecturer at Paris-Dauphine, where he teaches the [Python for Finance](teaching/index.qmd#python-for-finance) course at Master's level, and at Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne, where he teaches his own course, [Equity Quantitative Investment Strategies](teaching/index.qmd#equity-quantitative-investment-strategies), at Master's level.

In his free time, he enjoys doing [research](research/index.qmd) (asset pricing) and indoor climbing.

> *"All models are wrong, but some are useful."* — George E. P. Box
